_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: The coil reality (5% chance of ±2+ point moves) and analyst's poor directional accuracy make HOLD the statistically honest default, with a theoretical UP lean toward Hope contingent on the named breakers firing.
next_move.brains_agree: Partial — both see UP toward Hope as the forward path, but the analyst demands confirmation breakers first while the narrative writer treats it as higher-conviction and more imminent
next_move.confirmed_if: fear_greed rises above 30 with funding staying below 0.012% and BTC momentum holds 55+
next_move.invalidated_if: fear_greed drops below 20 OR funding spikes above 0.02% with BTC momentum fading below 50
